name: robots/elijah-waichong-chan__go2-convex-mpc
title: Unitree Go2 convex MPC scene (MuJoCo)
intro: Unitree Go2 convex MPC scene (MuJoCo), adapted from elijah-waichong-chan/go2-convex-mpc. It reads `time_ms`, `qpos`, `qvel`, `ctrl` and 4 more; runs `step` and `reset`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
